english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “keep” means to continue an action or course of action.
This is the all-purpose choice for proceeding with an activity or letting something carry on.
Use 繼續 as the all-purpose choice when continuing a task, topic, stage, or activity: the general idea of carrying on rather than physical movement.
This is the all-purpose choice when continuing an activity from where it stopped.
Use this when the emphasis is that an action, process, or condition carries on without stopping.

examples.english: We keep working hard and don't give up.
examples.traditional: 我哋繼續努力，唔好放棄。
